team.name: BUZZ BOIL TAPS
origin: It was our first CTF together. The organizers had a random name generator and forced everyone to be on it. They *rolled the dice*.
Out came *"Buzz Boil Taps"*. Meaningless. Perfect. We kept it, and apparently this is our amazing branding now.
mission: We're *three students* from the same school, same class, who'd rather be reversing a binary than doing homework. We play CTFs, ship things at hackathons, dig for bugs, and build hardware that sometimes works on the first try (haha, i know, amazing joke there).

members.name: Darsh Singhal
members.role: pwn / web exploitation / cloud exploitation / code guy
members.bio: You built it? I *break* it. You fixed it? *"You sure? :)"*. Other than that, I love python and can read (a tad bit) of assembly. I also like to build things and love AI stuff.
